assumptions: Reference AIO submits separate weight and scale reads per row, 4KiB aligned.
k=12 inferred from 6144 projection input/256 row width divided across TP2 ranks.
No request deduplication in inspected reference submitLocked; actual live implementation needs identity verification.
Read sizes can be 8KiB if absolute file offsets cause boundary crossing; 4KiB here is minimum, not measured SSD bytes.
limits: Gap excludes any overlapped work, so dividing requests by gap is not actual drive IOPS or latency.
O_DIRECT bypasses host page cache, not necessarily drive/controller caching or media read dedup.
